latestVersion.changelog:
to-generator-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from your text prompts, documents, or video files — no manual editing needed.
- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP4 uploads (up to 200MB); simply describe the scene or concept to generate.
- Automatic cloud session setup with free trial credits for new users; no account required to get started.
- Streamlined API interactions: upload, generate, edit, track credits, and export videos for content creators.
- All actions are accessible by natural language or simple commands; gets your video ready in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles errors gracefully and guides you through uploading, editing, exporting, and troubleshooting.
